verses.gurmukhi: ੬ : ਬਲਿ ਤੋਂ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਾਂ ਦੀ ਮਹਿਮਾਂ
verses.translit_en: 6 : bal to(n) charan kamalaa(n) dhee mahimaa(n)

en.bdb: Grandeur of the lotus feet in context with king Bali story

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਛਲਿ ਅਛਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: baavan roopee hoi kai bal chhal achhal aap chhalaiaa|

en.bdb: Assuming the form of Vaman (short statured brahmin) and remaining unsuccessful in beguiling king Bali

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰੋਂ ਅਢਾਈ ਧਰਤਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਵਡ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: karo(n) addaiee dharat ma(n)g pichho dhe vadd pi(n)dd vadhaiaa|

en.bdb: He Himself got beguiled. Having asked for two and a half steps of land, Vaman, afterwards enlarged His body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰੁਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਿੰਨਿ ਲੋਅ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਗਰੁ ਮਿਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhui karuvaa kar ti(n)n loa bal raaje fir magar minaiaa|

en.bdb: In two steps He measured all the three worlds and in a half step He measured the body of king Bali.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗਹੁ ਚੰਗਾ ਜਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਜੁ ਪਤਾਲ ਲੋਕ ਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: suragahu cha(n)gaa jaan kai raaj pataal lok dhaa paiaa|

en.bdb: Accepting the kingdom of netherworld better than heavens Bali started ruling it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲ ਦਰਵਾਨ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: brahamaa bisan mahes trai bhagat vachhal dharavaan sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: Now the Lord, in whom subsume Brahma, Visnu and Mahen, becoming lover of His devotees, served as a door keeper of king Bali

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਲਖ ਸੁ ਪਾਵਨਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਜ ਇਛ ਇਛਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: baavan lakh su paavanaa saadhasa(n)gat raj ichh ichhaiaa|

en.bdb: Many sacred incarnations like Vaman also have the wish of having the dust of the feet of holy congregation.
They also contemplate the feet of the Guru in the company of holy ones.
